prompt: I have an Umbraco 17 site. Create a custom dashboard Health Check that verifies Umbraco:CMS:Global:UseHttps is true in production, places it in the Security group, and gives editors a useful official documentation link. Tell me how to verify it in Settings > Health Check.
expectations: The response distinguishes a backoffice Health Check from a health probe endpoint
The implementation uses a stable HealthCheck attribute with a unique GUID, concise name, description, and Security group
The check reads Umbraco:CMS:Global:UseHttps and treats true as the recommended accepted value
The response links to the official .md Health Check documentation and gives Settings > Health Check verification steps
If a buildable project exists, the agent reports a successful build only after running it; otherwise it explicitly says build verification was unavailable
